test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18744814376f69820e3084a2fe869d121bd225cd1b2166e592c2cd1806974b8c.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first column elements shifts in the downward clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second and third column elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28231c306674674d6c5940134bbbbec9655770c86f23f9f7f6d90a2b0c68be9c.png] ​

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first element from first column and second element from second column shifts in the downward anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second element from first column, first element from second column and third column elements shifts in the downward clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5e1d80f77b81dec302f21f46273d633172b2437024ad83c04b27a978b79eb53.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32318f0580ed64f2912e76a8b15ecff79c23e282bb51dd8ac6ec38c073d80982.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
